findings.title: SDK Engineer - JavaScript
findings.summary: Own public JS/TS client SDKs (database, auth, storage, realtime, edge) used by millions of developers and AI coding tools; library authorship in the open with type-system depth and npm packaging.
findings.fit_summary: Snap AR Enterprise Web SDK tech lead plus merchant/SDK ownership at Vertebrae map directly to published TypeScript SDK maintenance, public API design, and developer-platform ownership.
missing_gaps: Expert-level TypeScript type-system design (conditional/mapped types as API surface)
High-volume public OSS maintainer triage at Supabase scale
evidence: Ashby JD: expert TypeScript, published library with external consumers, OSS maintainer experience, npm dual ESM/CJS

findings.title: Frontend Engineer
findings.summary: Studio + marketing/docs frontend: ship 0→1 product surfaces, own CI/quality pipelines for AI-assisted coding (types, tests, contracts, a11y, visual regression), work end-to-end across React/TS and API contracts.
findings.fit_summary: End-to-end React/TS product ownership from Snap/Vertebrae and Head-of-Eng shipping at Panorama AI match Studio 0→1 delivery plus platform-quality tooling for agent-written code.
missing_gaps: Deep CI quality-pipeline ownership specifically for AI coding agents (Vitest/Playwright/MSW budgets)
evidence: Ashby JD: React + TypeScript, SSR/streaming/RSC, 0→1 product launches, AI agent CI guardrails

findings.title: API Engineer
findings.summary: Maintain and expand Supabase Management API (TypeScript/Nest.js): public + internal APIs for Studio/CLI/OAuth, partner integrations (e.g. Vercel), reliability, and branching DX.
findings.fit_summary: Node/TypeScript backend, Postgres, and platform-API ownership across Panorama AI and Snap cloud services align with Nest.js management-API and OAuth/JWT platform work.
missing_gaps: Nest.js specifically called out as primary stack
Deep OAuth application / partner-integration track record not primary on resume
evidence: Ashby JD: 5+ years backend APIs, TypeScript/Node, Nest.js/Express/Vitest/Zod, Postgres, Docker/CI

findings.title: Supalite Engineer
findings.summary: Build Supabase Lite: TypeScript-native lightweight Supabase (SQLite/Postgres, PostgREST/Auth-compatible API) for AI builders and platform partners, plus upgrade path to full hosted Supabase.
findings.fit_summary: TypeScript platform/SDK and Postgres product experience plus LLM/AI product eng at Panorama AI fit a TS-native embeddable backend aimed at AI builders.
missing_gaps: SQLite ↔ Postgres conformance / PostgREST compatibility depth
evidence: Ashby JD: strong TypeScript backend/platform fluency, SQL/relational grounding, CLI/DX ownership

findings.title: CLI Engineer
findings.summary: Own supabase CLI and local-dev DX: TypeScript/NestJS backend APIs plus cross-platform CLI (Windows/Linux/macOS) aligned with platform capabilities.
findings.fit_summary: Developer-tooling and TypeScript/Node platform work (SDKs, cloud infra) plus strong DX instincts match CLI/local-dev ownership; NestJS is learnable from Express/Node depth.
missing_gaps: Hands-on CLI product ownership (subprocess/filesystem/terminal UX) not a headline resume theme
NestJS patterns called out as how the team ships
evidence: Ashby JD: TypeScript NestJS APIs + cross-platform CLI; 5+ years backend/DX tooling
Remote workplaceType; older publishedAt vs fresher SDK/Frontend roles

findings.title: Engineering Manager
findings.summary: New EM function across Interfaces, Platform, EngOps, and Databases: people/delivery leadership for remote async teams; technical bar-setting without expected day-to-day coding.
findings.fit_summary: Head of Engineering at Panorama AI (org standards, delivery, hiring) plus tech-lead ownership at Snap match the remote EM mandate; prefer matching to a platform/Interfaces team.
missing_gaps: JD expects managers not to contribute code directly (vs hands-on preference)
3+ years managing remote globally distributed teams as explicit bar
evidence: Ashby JD: 5+ years eng + 3+ years managing remote teams; cloud/SaaS/devtool preference
Quiet signals: leadership/TA posting EM hiring across teams

findings.title: AI Platform Engineer
findings.summary: Sole engineer building Supabase's internal AI agent execution platform: queues, model-agnostic runtime, durable state, human gates, evals/CI, governance, and agent portfolio on Python/GCP.
findings.fit_summary: Panorama AI Head of Eng (LLM products, pipelines, platform) overlaps agent/eval platform scope, but JD must-haves are narrower (shipped agent systems, MCP servers, Python/GCP IaC sole ownership).
missing_gaps: Must-have: production LLM agent systems with operational incidents (beyond product LLM features)
Must-have: end-to-end Python on GCP + warehouse + IaC as sole platform owner
evidence: Ashby JD titled AI Platform Engineer; Growth dept; strict must-haves on agents/evals/MCP/Python-GCP

findings.title: Edge Functions Engineer
findings.summary: Evolve Supabase Edge Runtime (Rust host + Deno isolates) and TypeScript edge functions platform: global compute, limits, OpenTelemetry, on-call.
findings.fit_summary: TypeScript edge/product experience and cloud platform ownership help on the functions surface, but the JD centers Rust Deno-runtime internals more than fullstack product eng.
missing_gaps: Rust-based edge runtime / Deno isolate host experience
Upstream Deno collaboration and runtime on-call depth
evidence: Ashby JD: Edge Runtime Rust+Deno, TypeScript edge functions, OTel, on-call
